description.value: Cafe Mexico is a Mexican Grill & Cantina on Store Street in Victoria, serving an extensive menu of tacos, enchiladas, alambres, and antojitos with clearly labeled vegetarian options throughout. The restaurant also boasts one of the more comprehensive tequila and mezcal selections in the city, with dozens of expressions listed. Touring cyclists arriving in downtown Victoria will find a full sit-down dining experience rooted in authentic Mexican flavours.
